resources.string: Rewarding Sustainability, One Point at a Time

Green Points is a mobile-based platform designed to support and enhance the waste management initiatives of Marikina City, led by the City Environmental Management Office (CEMO). The application promotes proper waste segregation and recycling by integrating a reward-based system that encourages active community participation.

By combining technology and environmental programs, Green Points allows users to earn points through responsible waste disposal practices. These points can be redeemed for rewards, making sustainability more engaging, accessible, and motivating for residents.

The platform builds upon Marikina\'s existing system by introducing real-time monitoring, digital tracking, and gamification features that align with modern lifestyles. It aims to strengthen environmental awareness, encourage consistent participation, and support the city\'s vision of sustainable urban development.

CEMO, developed for the City Environmental Management Office (CEMO) of Marikina City, is committed to safeguarding the privacy and personal information of its users. This Privacy Policy sets out how we collect, use, store, and protect the data you provide while using our application. By continuing to use the CEMO application, you acknowledge that you have read and agreed to the practices described in this policy.

To provide and continuously improve our services, we collect the following categories of information:

 • Personal Information — your name, email address, contact number, and barangay, provided during account registration.

 • Profile Photo — an optional image you may upload to personalize your account.

 • Recycling Activity — records of your recycling submissions, Green Points earned, and rewards claimed.

 • Device Information — basic technical data, such as operating system version, used to maintain app compatibility and performance.

 • Usage Data — general interaction data, including screens visited and features used, to help us enhance the overall user experience.

The information we collect is used exclusively for the following purposes:

 • To create, maintain, and manage your CEMO account.

 • To accurately track recycling activity and calculate Green Points earned.

 • To process reward claims and verify user eligibility.

 • To deliver relevant notifications regarding your account, recycling events, and reward updates.

 • To improve the functionality, usability, and overall performance of the application.

 • To fulfill legal obligations and address any disputes that may arise in connection with the service.

CEMO does not sell, rent, or trade your personal information to third parties. Your data may only be disclosed under the following limited circumstances:

 • Local Government Reporting — aggregated, non-identifiable recycling data may be shared with barangay authorities to support community-level environmental programs.

 • Trusted Service Providers — we engage reputable third-party infrastructure providers, such as Firebase by Google, to securely store and process data on our behalf. All such providers are bound by strict confidentiality and data protection obligations.

 • Legal Compliance — we may disclose information where required by applicable law or in response to a valid request from a competent public authority.

We retain your personal data for as long as your account remains active or as necessary to provide our services. If you submit a request to delete your account:

 • Your account will enter a 30-day grace period, during which it will be deactivated and inaccessible for use.

 • You may reactivate your account at any time within this 30-day period simply by logging in again.

 • If no action is taken within the 30-day period, your account and associated personal data will be permanently and irreversibly deleted from our active systems.

 • Certain recycling activity records may be retained in anonymized form for statistical and environmental reporting purposes, in compliance with local government requirements.

As a CEMO user, you are entitled to the following rights concerning your personal data:

 • Right to Access — you may request a copy of the personal data we hold on your behalf.

 • Right to Correction — you may update or correct your information at any time via the Edit Profile page.

 • Right to Deletion — you may initiate a request to delete your account and personal data at any time through the app, subject to the 30-day grace period described above.

 • Right to Withdraw Consent — you may withdraw your consent to data processing at any time, which may limit access to certain features of the application.

 • Right to Data Portability — you may request that your personal data be provided in a structured, commonly used, and machine-readable format.

 To exercise any of these rights, please contact us using the details provided below.

CEMO takes the security of user data seriously and implements the following measures to safeguard your information:

 • All data is stored using Google Firebase, which employs industry-standard encryption both at rest and in transit.

 • Passwords are never stored in plain text and are managed securely through Firebase Authentication.

 • Access to user data is restricted to authorized personnel only, on a need-to-know basis.

 • Our data handling practices are reviewed on an ongoing basis to align with current security standards.

 While we take reasonable measures to protect your information, no method of electronic transmission or storage can be guaranteed to be completely secure. We encourage all users to maintain a strong, unique password for their account.

Should you have any questions, concerns, or requests regarding this Privacy Policy or the handling of your personal data, please contact us through the following channels:

 • Email: cemo.marikina.ph@gmail.com

 • Address: City Environmental Management Office (CEMO), Marikina City, Metro Manila, Philippines

 We endeavor to respond to all privacy-related inquiries within five (5) to seven (7) business days.
Thank you for reading our Privacy Policy.
